title: fix(spec): os migrate meta --stored lists a stored connector_action whose connectorConfig.input carries a {…} token
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWTzpNAW9u4yThhaHTFm1K9)_

Fixes #28163

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os migrate meta --stored` 的“已存储但新版本会拒收”清单，现在会列出 `connector_action` 节点 `connectorConfig.input` 里带 `{…}` 旧模板记号的值，位置写成 `connectorConfig.input.KEY`，归在 `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged` 这条升级条目下。
- 为什么改：上一版（#28150）让启动时的 `registerFlow` 拒收这种流程，但迁移预览只看节点的 `config`，看不到 `connectorConfig`，运维升级前用这个工具查不到它，升级后流程直接不注册、不运行。
- 风险与回滚：只改“列出”这一步，不改任何存储行，也不改任何门的判定；`config` 里的值照旧列在原条目下。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`（新的共用遍历 `forEachFlowValueSlotRefusal` 和新检测器 `connectorActionInputTemplateToken`），`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`（#28163 一节）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`，预期 80 个测试全过，其中 “one TODO under the connector input entry, at connectorConfig.input.KEY” 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（等契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- **One walk, the door's call.** `forEachFlowValueSlotRefusal` walks every node of every stored flow (region bodies included) and calls `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals(node.type, node.config, node)`. That is the call `registerFlow` (`flow-registration-checks.ts`) and `objectstack validate` (`validate-expressions.ts`) make, so the listing reads the same ledger, including the `connectorConfig · input.*` entry #28150 added. No second list of node types or paths exists.
- **Two detectors, split by the block each refusal names.**
  - `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` keeps the `config` refusals. Its path, `from` and reason are unchanged.
  - New `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged` takes the `connectorConfig` refusals. It lists them at `NODE_PATH.connectorConfig.input.KEY`, with the judge's own message (the value's CEL spelling).
- **Why a second detector, not the suggested single one.** A detector's `id` is the D3 entry of the retirement that refuses the shape (header of `refused-shapes.ts`, pinned by `names each refused shape by a D3 entry of its step`). #28150 registered the connector-input refusal as its own D3 entry, `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged`. The `flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused` entry's surface names `config` only, and its reason says "the template resolved a token CEL reads differently". For this slot that is false: the action was handed the token's text as written, as the #28150 entry says. So the row is listed under the entry that refuses it, with a reason that holds for it. Both detectors share the one walk and the one judge. The route is otherwise the order's.
- **The header invariant** ("a site is listed here exactly when that door refuses it") now names that the judge is handed the whole node, as the doors hand it.
- Changeset `28163-stored-connector-input-listed.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, both declaration lines.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`, new `#28163` block:

- A stored row with `input: { text: '{record.name}', queue: 'support' }` (through `applyConversionsToStoredItem`) gives one TODO: `conversionId` `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged`, path `flows[0].nodes[1].connectorConfig.input.text`, `from` the token string, and a reason naming the flow, the node, the slot and the CEL envelope. The row is returned byte-identical.
- A nested value (`tags[1]`) in a connector node inside a loop body is listed at `...config.body.nodes[0].connectorConfig.input.tags[1]`.
- A loose `config.input` that the D2 lift moves onto `connectorConfig` is listed at the lifted path. The listing judges the converted row, as boot does.
- Controls: a CEL envelope, a literal and an absent `input` are not listed.
- Agreement with the door: on a mixed flow, the listed paths equal the judge's refusals when handed the node, as a set (one `config` filter operand, one `connectorConfig` input value), each under its own id.
- Block pin: `config` plus `FLOW_NODE_SIBLING_EXPRESSION_BLOCKS` equals `['config', 'connectorConfig']`, so a new sibling block reds here until it has a detector.
- The registered-id pin gains the new id in report order.

<details><summary>Ablation: removing the node argument turns the new cases red</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts --anchor 'flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals(typed.type, node.config, node)' --replacement 'flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals(typed.type, node.config)'`. The anchor hit once (1 → 0, blob `88279418` → `46343966`). The suite went to Tests 4 failed | 76 passed (80): the stored-row case, the nested/region case, the lifted-loose case and the door-agreement case. The controls stayed green, as expected, since nothing is listed either way. The file was restored to its HEAD blob `88279418` with `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the module from source, so no `dist` rebuild is involved.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Not listed, by design of this card:** the same D3 entry also covers a malformed CEL envelope in `connectorConfig.input`, which `registerFlow` refuses through the value-envelope judge. No refused-shape detector lists a malformed envelope in any value slot, `config` included. That is the existing scope of `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` (template tokens), not something this PR widens. Noted for the seat, not filed.
- The `connector-action-input-value-slot-judged` entry's acceptance text names the boot `warn` as the locator for a row that exists only in `sys_metadata`. That stays true. The entry does not yet say that `os migrate meta --stored` lists the row too. Editing it is outside this card's file surface, so it is left for the seat.
